name: Bridgeport YMCA Summer Day Camp
description_short: A traditional summer day camp run by the Bridgeport YMCA for children and teens. Activities include exploring nature, swimming, games and making friends.
special_needs_notes: If a child needs special assistance or medicine at camp, the camp may also require an Individual Care Plan and a Medicine Authorization form.
